// Planted public API of the ./hashurl entry point, the version after the change.

/** The new name of plantedRenamedOld. */
export function plantedRenamedNew(): number {
	return 2;
}

/** Gained a required parameter. */
export function plantedSignature(a: number, b: string): number {
	return a + b.length;
}

/** The replacement of plantedDeprecated. */
export function plantedReplacement(a: number): number {
	return a;
}

/**
 * Kept for callers of the old name.
 *
 * @deprecated Use plantedReplacement.
 */
export function plantedDeprecated(a: number): number {
	return plantedReplacement(a);
}

/** Added by the change. */
export function plantedAdded(): number {
	return 3;
}

/** An interface that loses a member and keeps one, and gains one. */
export interface PlantedShape {
	kept: string;
	added?: boolean;
}

/** A class that loses a method and keeps one. */
export class PlantedClass {
	kept(): number {
		return 1;
	}
}
